name: python-fastapi
description: Python FastAPI with uvicorn and poetry

files.pyproject.toml:
[tool.poetry]
name = "{{PROJECT_NAME}}"
version = "0.1.0"
description = ""
authors = ["Your Name <you@example.com>"]

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.11"
fastapi = "^0.115.0"
uvicorn = {extras = ["standard"], version = "^0.32.0"}
pydantic = "^2.0.0"

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
black = "^24.0.0"
isort = "^5.13.0"
mypy = "^1.13.0"
pytest = "^8.0.0"

[build-system]
requires = ["poetry-core"]
build-backend = "poetry.core.masonry.api"
